notes.title: Indie Assemble Festival
notes.notes:
Get ready to face the unknown! 
Black Cat Superstition is also part of Indie Assemble — the global festival celebrating the creative power of indie games!
From May 5th to 11th, uncover mysteries, challenges, and… superstitions!
